# Security Policy

All employees must complete the annual security awareness training within
30 days of their start date. Failure to complete the training results in
temporary suspension of VPN access until it is finished. The training takes
approximately 45 minutes and is available in the learning portal.

Production database credentials are issued per-engineer and rotate every 90
days. Never share credentials over Slack or email. If you believe a
credential has been exposed, page the on-call security engineer immediately
rather than waiting for business hours.

Every service that handles customer payment data must pass a quarterly
penetration test before its next release. The security team schedules these
tests and the results block deployment until all critical findings are
resolved.

This document is maintained by the People Operations team. For questions,
contact peopleops@northwind.example. Last reviewed March 2026.
